Numerical simulation for the Generic Hypersonic Vehicle model and scramjet engine is done for different cases of the aerodynamic coefficient bias. The results show the accuracy and the effectiveness of this optimal guidance algorithm.

articleTitle: A numerical method for artillery recoil resistance calculation
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: A new method on the simulation of the floating automatic of artillery is presented in this paper. The calculation expressions of floating automatic spring forces and hydraulic resistances are deduced by analyzing the mechanical characters of the artillery. The recoil resistance is calculated in a new way based on the finite element method using the APDL (ANSYS parametric Design Language). During the simulation process, the dynamic coupling effect between floating automatic components and other parts of the artillery have been taken into consideration. Seven running fire experimentation was carried out during which the recoil displacements of the receiver were measured. The effective of the program was verified through the comparison of the results of simulation and experimentation. The method proposed in this paper can improve the veracity of simulation especially in the analytic process of vibration responses of artillery system.

articleTitle: A fast binocular vision stereo matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: To resolve the problem of large computational cost and complexity of current binocular vision stereo matching algorithm, a fast Indoor stereo matching algorithm based on line moments and the angle vector is presented. Firstly, the method detects image edge using Canny operator, and finds the target objects according line moments, then feature points of the objects' contours are extracted. Finally, matching the pixel in stereo image pair according the angle vector. The algorithm effectively reduces the computational complexity, computational cost is decreased greatly. The experimental results show that The algorithm is possible and valid.

articleTitle: A novel target tracking approach based on ORB used in micromanipulation system
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Micromanipulation robot is a system which often does some precise manipulations in micro scale space, such as centimeter or millimeter level space, in which micro visual servo system plays a very important role. In visual servo system, it's difficult to give consideration to two or more things such as location accuracy and real-time property at the same time. In this paper, we introduced a novel approach which suited our system very well and could meet both of the above requirements. It was called ORB, a novel feature extracting method which outperformed many current excellent methods such as SIFT and SURF.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a high-precision underwater electric field measurement system
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Electric field measurement system is an important basis to study the characteristics of underwater electric field caused by ships, and its operating efficiency and reliability play a key role in the research. A new underwater electric field measurement system using multi-sensor array is designed, can get electric field signal of an underwater plane simultaneous, improved test efficiency. The system used a distributed control technology, improved equipment's reliability and scalability by set aside several redundant data paths.

articleTitle: The selection algorithm of precedence rows based task assignment solution for vehicle-target pursuit system
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper the task assignment for multi-target pursuit (MTP) problem with non-equal number of vehicle and target is studied. A mixed-inter programming (MILP) based minimax assignment criterion is formed, and a solution method called the Selection Algorithm of Precedence Rows (SAPR) originated from Operation on Matrix is presented. The simulations with less number and more number of targets being pursued are designed respectively to testify the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Generalized predictive control with constraints for autonomous underwater vehicle depth control
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The technology of AUV maneuvering control is important to the integrate performance in AUV voyage. This paper focus on the predictive control with constrains for AUV maneuvering, which aims to solve the problem of constrains in the AUV maneuvering based on predictive control theory. There are several constrains in depth control such as maximum rudder speed and deflection, maximum pitch et al. The multivariable predictive control with constrains is applied to the depth control. Pitch with different constrains shows several control modes of depth. Even if the manipulated variables remain only one, either of bow rudder or stern rudder, the depth was still under control. The autopilot performs well which is valid in experiment.

articleTitle: Hamiltonian-based binocular visual servoing of camera-in-hand robotic systems
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: An image-based strategy visual servo control via Hamiltonian function method for camera-in-hand robotic systems is considered. Firstly, a Hamiltonian realization is proposed for the visual servoing system. We proposed an image based visual servo controller for a new binocular stereo vision model which can avoid estimating depth information. Secondly, in accordance with the Hamiltonian realization method the visual servoing system can be modeled as a port-controlled Hamiltonian (PCH) system. For the PCH system, the stability analysis is given. Finally, simulation results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: A 12-pulse converter featuring a rotating magnetic field transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: A 12-Pulse Converter generally uses a phase-shifting transformer to get two sets of three-phase voltages, but the magnitude of the line current harmonic is too high. In this paper, a new type of 12-Pulse Converter featuring a rotating magnetic field transformer is presented. The design is based on the rationale of the induction machine, which can effectively reduce the line current harmonic and improve the power quality of the converter's DC output voltage.

articleTitle: Optimization control method with system condition online monitor for cleaning process
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The cleaning process is an important step in sugar refinery and features strong nonlinearity, a long sampling time to obtain quality data, multiple constraints imposed by practical requirements, its control goal is to acquire high density products. This paper presented an intelligent optimization control method, using improved back-propagation neural networks modeling of quality prediction and system condition online monitor, optimization be realized by c-means clustering, genetic and chaos approaches. The control system is implemented by DCS. The results of actual runs demonstrate the validity of the method.

articleTitle: A modified Attitude Determination Algorithm using low-cost sensors
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: According to the specific application of the Micro Air Vehicle (MAV), a modified Attitude Determination Algorithm is proposed. The presented system consists of a three-axis magnetometer, a three-axis accelerometer and a single-antenna Global Position Systems (GPS) receiver. Firstly, the earth's magnetic and specific force in the body and navigation frame is employed to establish the attitude quaternion. Subsequently, in order to improve performance, a standard linear measurement equation and a state equation about quaternion error is developed for Extend Kalman Filter (EKF). Finally, the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation using data collected from the low-cost sensors. The performance of the suggested algorithm is shown to have significantly restrained the estimation errors.

articleTitle: Research autonomous motion control for snake robot based on bionic learning strategy
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: To solve the problems of difficultly making certain the control parameters and the unideal motion performance of snake robot, we develop a bionic autonomous strategy based on operant conditioning mechanism, which can realize autonomously optimize and adjust control parameters. The designed strategy is a 5-tupe and mainly contains: 1) state space; 2) action space; 3) state transfer function, meaning the consequence after action; 4) tendency function; 5) action selection strategy, adjusting the selected probability of each action. The designed bionic strategy is applied to motion control of snake robot. The experiment analysis is carried out combined with webots robot simulation software. The results of the simulation experiment indicate that the skill of autonomous optimization adjustment control parameters will gradually be enhanced with the learning proceeding.

articleTitle: Analysis of the hybrid scheduling algorithm in the gird environment
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Considering traditional task scheduling algorithm in gird environment can't balance node load and meet needs of the user quality of service, mixed calculation of the traditional algorithm can improve the scheduling time and meet the user quality of service. By using strong global search ability of genetic algorithm and the advantages of high precision of the ant colony algorithm, it proposes hybrid scheduling method of a combination of the two algorithms. Experiments show that the hybrid scheduling algorithm can reduce completion time of the task, improve the efficiency of resource scheduling, and efficiency in large-scale task scheduling is superior to genetic algorithms and ant colony algorithm. This mixed scheduling policy can make load balancing degree of the gird system better, Succeed in solving the gird task scheduling problem and has broad application prospects in the gird task scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: A novel small dim infrared target detecting method based on grayscale merging and connected components analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Target detecting algorithm in infrared image is drawing extensive attention both at home and abroad, expecially when the infrared images own complex backgrounds and low resolution. How to make sure of the accuracy of infrared dim-small target detecting is the key point during the processing procedure. In this paper, a novel region of interest detecting algorithm is proposed for aerial small dim infrared target with clutter background. Different from traditional region of interest extraction method, we extract region of interest based on the grayscale merging algorithm and connected components analysising approach. First, the infrared image is reconstructed by separating the grayscale into several interval sections, then binarization is used to segment the processed image according to estimate the threshold value using minimum error probability; finally, analysis and select the connected components, to sift the accurate connected domain which contain the target. The validity of the proposed approach is demonstrated by experiment of infrared target region extraction.

articleTitle: A classification regulation congestion control algorithm based on queue strategy
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: With the fast growth of the internet users and applications, and the appearance of CPS (Cyber Physical Systems) in the future, a mass of equipments will be connected with the network, so the congestion is a very significant problem in the internet. This paper will place emphasis on two problems to solve the network congestion. The one is that the strategies do not affect other queue of normal transmission when solving some congestion problem of router's queue. The other is that according to the type of data packets which are in the global cache to transmit. This paper will get a reasonable control strategy according to global cache regulation, setting the threshold of global and local and the bubble sort principle. Eventually make the transmission of the data packets fair and reasonable when the network congests.

articleTitle: Second order sliding mode controller for space rovers
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper proposes a second order sliding mode (SOSM) controller for space rovers. The space rovers are operated in hostile and remote environment which can degrade its performance. The unknown disturbances are controlled by using a robust controller. The properties of SOSM make it the superior choice over other controllers. The aim of this paper is to design a SOSM controller for two wheel non-holonomic rover. The rover controller is designed to follow the reference trajectories. The simulation result shows the effectiveness of the proposed controller and the Stability is proved through the use of a Lyapunov function.

articleTitle: Application of ACOTS hybrid algorithm for job shop scheduling problems
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In the paper, we propose a hybrid algorithm ACOTS for improving the performance of intelligence optimization algorithm for solving job shop scheduling problems. In ACOTS algorithm, the ACO algorithm was applied to search in the global solution space, and TS algorithm was utilized as the local algorithm. This paper had not only proved the global asymptotic convergence of the hybrid algorithm by Markov chain theory of stochastic processes, but also applied the ACOTS algorithm to 13 hard benchmark problems, which has demonstrated the effectiveness of the hybrid algorithm.

articleTitle: Improved method of acquiring the attitude changing duration of an agile imaging satellite
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Attitude changing duration between tasks is a main restriction of the task scheduling for an agile imaging satellite. Its value is quite difficult to acquire while considering the rotation of the earth, the movement of the satellite on its orbit, the visible time windows to the tasks and the attribute of the satellite. Besides, the efficiency improvement of its obtaining method is also significant for it would repeatedly run for thousands of times and consume a lot of time during the scheduling. In order to solve the problem, a spacial kinematic model is established by analyzing the constraints. Based on the model, an improved method is given to acquire the attitude changing duration. Simulation results show the efficiency of our approach.

articleTitle: A stage-structured predator-prey model with the Beddington-DeAngelis functional response
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper, by applying the comparison principle and the novel analytical techniques we investigate the permanence of a stage-structured predator-prey model with Beddington-DeAngelis functional response. Some sufficient conditions ensuring the extinction of predator and the permanence of the considered system are established. These conditions, on the one side, show how all the system parameters including the effect of mutual interference among predators work together to determine the permanence of predator-prey systems; on the other side, they present a insightful and realistic perspective to perceive the biological significance of the model.

articleTitle: Bank-to-turn control design for no-power lift-body reentry flight vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Bank-to-turn control is far superior to slid-to-turn control at maneuverability, stableness, lift-to-drag ratio and it is adapt to lift-body reentry vehicle. In this paper, the BTT guidance logic was discussed, a two cycles attitude control system was build in which lateral slid angle was suppressed through adjustable branches. Simulation result shows that the lateral silde angle was limited within 0.3° and can converge to 0° repidly.

articleTitle: Infrared image edge extraction based on the lateral inhibition network and a new denoising method
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The infrared images processing method based on the lateral inhibition network has disadvantages like losing some details of the target or adding noise. Another problem is the parameter of lateral inhibition cannot be chosen adaptively. In the area of infrared guidance, these problems could increase possibility of misrecognition, and lower accuracy of hitting targets. In this paper, we review the theory behind the registration and reconstruction algorithms and their limitations. Because Exponential Function has no parameter to set, this study proposes a method that replaces Gauss Function with Exponential Function to solve the problem of details losing and adaptively image processing. Additionally a method is proposed to remove noise in infrared binary image according to analysis of the neighborhood pixels values of noise point. The results indicate that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of arch dam withstand underwater explosion
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Based on the software LS-DYNA-970, Centered finite difference finite element method, this paper is focus on analyse the physical processes of an explosion blast in water and the response of the arch dam. As the processes are complicated, a dynamic finite element model was developed. The calculation gives out the displacement and the acceleration time-history curves of important points. The results show that: Under the shock waves of underwater explosion, the response of arch dam in horizontal way is much larger than the way in vertical way; The degree of response depended on the distance of the point and the center point of explosion.

articleTitle: System identification based anti-torque flap design
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The ducted-fan UAVs have potential for missions in urban environments, but there are still some problems in attitude control. In this paper, a dynamic model of the propeller-engine and anti-torque flap was established based on experiments and simulations, and the flap sizes were also calculated as the propeller-torque was equal to the flap-torque. Inaccuracy of the engine simulation and the high complexity of the wind tunnel test can be avoided by using this approach. Flight test results show that the ducted-fan vehicle could hover steadily along the vertical axis with the chosen flap inside.

articleTitle: Optimal analysis of flow parameters for marine gas turbine intercooler based on simulation model
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The mathematical model of intercooled cycle gas turbine was established and the relative simulation model was also built based on MATLAB/SIMULINK. Under a given structure size of intercooler, many magnificent conclusions were drawn over the analyses of influence of different liquid side flow parameters on the intercooler system performance. The simulation experimental results show the increase of glycol water flow and seawater flow can improve the performance of intercooler, but the performance isn't better as the flow of glycol water and seawater is larger. The rational flow rates should be chosen according to flow conditions. The influence of seawater inlet temperature on intercooler efficiency is significant and need to be considered in the optimal design.

articleTitle: Control scheme of hybrid inverters in high power drives
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: A control method is developed for a AC drive system, built of a parallel interconnection of a GTO primary inverter and a IGBT slave inverter, feeding a large induction motor where torque ripple attenuation is a primary concern. The GTO inverter is the main power supply and the IGBT inverter is used as an active filter to attenuate the current ripple due to the GTO low switching frequency. The proposed master-slave control scheme combines the best features in comparison of the equivalent voltage-source inverter such as low switching losses and fast current-control dynamics. In the paper the performances of the proposed control scheme are illustrated by using simulations.

articleTitle: Non-linear data analysis of impedance spectroscopy as applied to cellular toxicity systems
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper introduces an impedance measurement system that can be performed non-destructively to detect cellular toxicity with a cell culture system. This study examines ECV304 cells grown in culture well and exposed to toxicant dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO). The spectra output from the impendence analyzer can visualize the difference between the cellular responds at low and high concentration of DMSO challenge. In order to further process and compare the cellular behavior challenged at three concentrations of DMSO, an equivalent circuit model based on the electrode/insulator/solution interface is described. This paper also investigates Hilbert-Huang transformation (HHT), which is an adaptive analysis technique to non-linear and non-stationary signals. HHT spectra provide a measure of energy in the whole frequency range varies with different concentrations of toxicant.

articleTitle: Research on the feature of hydraulic oil of electro-hydraulic pump
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The full paper begins with the importance of electro-hydraulic pump which is a highly integrated combination of electric motor and hydraulic pump. The development of electro-hydraulic pump, which integrates interdisciplinary theories, in our opinions, does study on all kinds of performances. We now present our finite element model on flow and temperature field of the fluid which we believe can much facilitate the research. In the paper, the said model was explained in some details; in this abstract, we just add some associated remarks to naming the topics, such as the momentum equations, energy equation and mass equation. Finally we utilize ANSYS software to perform computer simulation and the results are shown in the full paper. These results show the performance on velocity and temperature of the electro-hydraulic pump, and the future direction of design.

articleTitle: Intelligent fault diagnosis system for new assembly transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The paper introduces an intelligent fault diagnosis system for new assembly transmission. Order analysis method is used to analysis and process vibration signal of automotive transmission. After the initial set of feature vectors is obtained, improved genetic search strategy is used to select feature, so as to reduce the dimension of feature vector set, and feature vector sets selected are input into the BP neural network for fault identification and classification of assembly transmission. A large number of data are collected from industrial site and analyzed, validity and accuracy of proposed algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Business information supply chain modeling and simulation methodology
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Business information supply chain management in today's business climate characterized are with high uncertainty. Globalization of business, outsourcing, shorter transaction cycles, and high end user expectations require effective solutions for business information supply chain. Simulation can be a valuable tool for business information supply chain analysis, planning, optimization, evaluation, and risk management. This paper presents a methodology for modeling both structure and dynamics of complex business information supply chain based on process approach. It also describes the model-driven simulation methodology and the main components of the simulation software solution: model database, process library, knowledge base, and execution engine. Finally, simulation results of the case supply network are presented.

articleTitle: A new survey on dynamic programming to distributed control of random system
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper we consider the problem of computing decentralized control policies for stochastic systems with finite state and action spaces. Synthesis of optimal decentralized policies for such problems is known to be NP-hard [15]. Here we focus on methods for efficiently computing meaningful suboptimal decentralized control policies. The algorithms we present here are based on approximation of optimal Q-functions. We show that the performance loss associated with choosing decentralized policies with respect to an approximate Q-function is related to the approximation error. We demonstrate the methods developed in this paper with an example of load balancing in a queuing network.

articleTitle: Parameters identification of synchronous machine based on sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper summarized the testing methods of main parameters in synchronous generator, studied the sensibility of generator output acted on its parameters under sorts of experimental conditions and obtained a testing method of sorts of parameters in a generator. Based on symmetrical shortcut experiment of stable state, with the help of analyzing the ready-to-discerning parameters sensibility, the q-axis reactance of stable state was measured by changing series-wound resistors to alter the sensibility of q-axis parameters of stable state. The simulation analysis and experiment show that the method put forth in the paper is effective and the parameters measured by this method are accurate.

articleTitle: A transformation approach from informal descriptions of SWRL to built-in elements of protégé4.1
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: To support automated reasoning of the rules for the cooperation between Goal and Process and achieve the on-demand modifications of operational process in some degree, based on our previous work, an approach for transforming the informal descriptions of SWRL into the built-in elements of protégé4.1 is proposed in this paper. The concept of the built-in elements in protégé4.1 is specified in this paper to indicate the mapping relationships from the informal descriptions of SWRL to the built-in elements of protégé4.1. According to the mapping relationship, the transformation approach is concluded and illustrated with a simple case. Then the rules for the cooperation between Goal and Process which is in the informal descriptions of SWRL are transformed into corresponding built-in elements of protégé4.1 through the approach. In this paper, automated reasoning support is provided for the dynamic evolution of Process model and its visualization through reasoning engine Pellet.

articleTitle: Maximal power extraction of variable speed wind turbine under rated wind speed
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In order to extract the maximal power from the wind under the rated wind speed, a sliding mode controller is designed in this paper for a variable speed wind turbine (VSWT), the proposed control algorithm possesses the properties to overcome the nonlinearity, uncertainty and external disturbance within VSWT, it drives the turbine rotor to rotate toward desired tracking speed to maximally harvest the wind power under the rated wind speed. The results of simulation studies show that the effectiveness and the advantages of the designed controller.

articleTitle: On designing time-delay feedback controller for master-slave synchronization of singular Lur'e systems
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of designing a time-delay output feedback controller for the master-slave synchronization of singular Lur'e systems. Based on the generalized Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional theory, a new delay-dependent synchronization criterion is derived by dividing the time delay into two intervals and designing different energy functions in each interval. The controller design algorithm is also given in terms of strict linear matrix inequality. A numerical example is used to illustrate the effectiveness of the design method.

articleTitle: An adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy control approach for motion control of a spacecraft maneuver
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy control approach to predict the torque required to control the attitude and rate in a spacecraft maneuver. In the real world environment, the mathematical models of many complex systems are often not accurate, due to the presence of continuous disturbances that effect their dynamic equations, in addition to errors in parameter knowledge. Consequently, methods that rely less on precise mathematical models are often preferred. One such Adaptive Machine Learning Technique is proposed for motion control in spacecraft maneuver. The controller uses an inverse learning Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) model only to train itself from certain desired trajectories and tries to mimic the same in its response. Ideally, these training trajectories are obtained by directly measuring the spacecraft manuever response for various test inputs. Once the system is fully trained, the manuever is tested on a new trajectory with uncertain plant dynamics. However, for algorithm validation, trajectories generated through simulations based on mathematical models assumed to be reasonably accurate, can also be used for the training purpose. This approach is used for design and implementation of an ANFIS controller which is shown to work satisfactorily. Further possible developments of the method are outlined.

articleTitle: Research on classification method of wavelet entropy and Fuzzy Neural Networks for motor imagery EEG
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Since traditional electrical brain signal analysis is mostly qualitative, the development of new quantitative methods is crucial for restricting the subjectivity in the study of brain signals. These methods are particularly fruitful when they are strongly correlated with intuitive physical concepts that allow a better understanding of brain dynamics [1]. Here, new method based on wavelet entropy (WE) and Fuzzy Neural Networks (FNN) is applied. The WE carries information about the degree of order/disorder associated with a multi-frequency signal. In addition, the time evolution of the WE is calculated to give information about the dynamics in the EEG records. Within this framework, the major objective of the present work was to characterize in a quantitative way functional dynamics of order/disorder microstates in short duration EEG signals. This paper has tried to use fuzzy neural networks (FNN) as a classification method, which combines fuzzy membership and neural network frame, to drive the model automatically update in training and leaning processes, thus it can be applied in the simulations of complex conditions. In this way, EEG signals under motor imagery conditions were analyzed.

articleTitle: Repetitive control design of simulation turntable based on integral sliding mode
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Considering the reference input signal and disturbances of simulation turntable system are periodic, a design method of the repetitive control system based on the integral sliding mode is proposed to improve the tracking performance and robust performance for turntable system. Due to there existing uncertainty in the turntable system, the turntable system is extended to an uncertain system with mismatching uncertainties. A sufficient condition of system stability is derived in terms of a linear matrix inequality (LMI), and based on this condition, an iterative algorithm is presented to calculate the large cut-off angular frequency of the repetitive controller and the parameters of the stabilizing controller. Finally, the validity of this proposed method is verified by a simulation table system.

articleTitle: Modeling and controlling of engineering ship based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper, the model of engineering ship was presented. The ship has no movements' ability by itself. Its' motion is adjusting the length of anchor chain controls the course of engineering ship. It limits the moving scope of the ship and makes it not drift about wantonly. But while moving and mooring the ship, because wind, wave, flow and various kinds of random influence is difficult to be predicted, it is difficult to control of the course. Therefore, fuzzy controller is used to improve the controlling performance of the ship, and to accurate precision of geotextiles-laying. A fuzzy logic controller for dynamic positioning of engineering ship in Changjiang River is presented. The core of the fuzzy controller is a set of fuzzy associative memory rules that correlate each group of fuzzy control input sets to a fuzzy control output set. And genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the rule of fuzzy controller, which enables the controller to produce the better result in case of no priori knowledge. Finally, the mathematics model of the ship is set up and simulation is carried on to the system.

articleTitle: A rapid layout model of manipulation devices in cockpit
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: To avoid the limitation of manipulation devices design and arrangement in cockpit by current design methods, a rapid layout model of manipulation devices has been built based on the layout guidelines of manipulation devices and the pilot joint model which is human centred. The model is capable of calculating the relative position of the design eye position (DEP), neutral seat reference point (NSRP) and manipulation devices quickly, which enables a rapid arrangement of manipulation devices. The model is verificated by a simple layout of manipulation devices in an aircraft through CATIA platform. The results show that the model can avoid complex iterative process during designing, shorten design cycle and save expense.

articleTitle: Adaptive PID controllers with specifications on phase and amplitude margins
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper presents a new technique of adaptive PID controller with specifications on phase and amplitude margins. On the basis of process input and output data of normal operation in the control loop, the important frequency responses of process are estimated with signal decomposition and Laplace analysis, and then a second-order plus dead-time transform function is identified as well. Finally PID control parameters are calculated to satisfy both phase and amplitude margins. The adaptive procedure of PID controller does not need any prior knowledge of the process and previous controller while the control loop is still in the normal operation. Simulation examples are given to show both effectiveness and feasibility of the adaptive PID controller.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive excitation controller design based on sliding mode control and neural network disturbances observers
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper proposed a robust adaptive excitation controller based on Neural Network Disturbances Observers(NNDO) and sliding mode control for SMIB power system. Main theory result is firstly presented and then a dynamic controller is constructered for a class of general nonlinear uncertain system by using neural network and sliding mode control.Neural network is used as an estimator of external disturbances and which be compensated in the controller. Sliding mode dynamic is designed at the last step for enhancing the ability of attenuating uncertainty of the system. Finally,we apply the control strategy into SMIB power system. Simulation is performed and the result shows that the proposed controller is effective for attenuating disturbances.

articleTitle: Application of building energy detection system based on OPC technology
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: As developing and integrating energy consumption detection system become more and more difficult, OPC technology is used to simplify the system. The integration of system can be improved largely and the development work can be decreased through OPC standard interface. Firstly, this paper introduces relative knowledge about OPC technology, and then realizes hardware and software development of energy consumption detection system in Shenyang large-scale public buildings. Through the adoption of OPC technology, simplifying the integration environment and realizing information sharing and exchange on high-levels.

articleTitle: The study of metallurgical automation based on integrated model of the enterprise bus
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Today, there is Widespread automation of information silos in the metallurgical industry phenomenon, resulting in duplication of investment, the system difficult to expand to expand the data sources are inconsistent, management and maintenance of heavy workload. So the enterprise bus-based integrated model to manage the various processes in the production of metallurgical enterprises, not only improve efficiency but also reduce investment and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Different techniques to improve the data speed of WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: WiMAX is one of wireless communication technologies can provide the high speed access service in future 4G networks. It has a big advantage over other competing technologies, such as, free to use, high speed data rate and long range communication. Therefore, for these reasons, WiMAX has attracted so much interest from researchers in the past few years. This paper investigates the various methods of achieving the improved performance of WiMAX in terms of the highest data rate by reviewing the available modulation techniques, OFDM and MIMO. The simulation models are developed to analyze the performance of the above techniques. The results of the simulation models will be presented and discussed to guide the system planners and designers to understand the reasons for what technique is appropriate to use in WiMAX to achieve and maintain the highest data rate.

articleTitle: Research of coordinated control method of hybrid power crane system
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper, as the problems of resource shortage and environment degradation become more and more serious, finding a sustainable development which can make society, economy, resource and environment coordinate with each other has become the international tide. Traditional crane is becoming one of the important researching objects in the energy-saving and environmental-protection field because of its high petrol consumption, low efficiency, and severe pollution and wasting of gravitational potential energy. Therefore, producing crane with the characteristics of high efficiency, energy saving and environment protection is an important aim for many companies at home and abroad which apply strategy of sustainable development. This paper analyzes the energy distribution among the mechanisms of hybrid power crane based on super capacitor working as the energy storage device. Followed by a study on the characteristics of the crane system, a coordinated control strategy of the engine-electrical system is proposed to achieve stable operation at the rated speed required by the handle instruction without being affected by the fluctuant external voltage and load current.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on the water inrush of minor faults in coal seam floor
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Based on mechanical analysis and numerical simulation, the water inrush of minor faults concealed in coal seam floor is discussed. The sliding condition of minor fault is obtained with elasticity model which is caused by the disturbance stress. And the water inrush models of minor faults are established with RFTA-FLOW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2D</sup> software. It shows that there are three stages in the process of minor fault's water inrush, including the active stage, expanding stage and fissure transfixion stage. With the understanding of stress, damage and seepage flow evolution, the transformation of floor rock mass from water-resisting strata to inrush pathways is clearly illuminated and the groundwater inrush pathways are calibrated. Furthermore, the influence of the density of faults on the damage evolution of groundwater inrush is studied. And some significantly meaningful guides are provided for the investigation on the mechanism and prevention of minor fault's water inrush in practice.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of pump controlled motor speed servos with/without a position loop
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Mathematic models and a test system of pump controlled motor speed servos (PCMSS) with /without a position loop are established and their dynamic performances are studied by simulation and experiments. Results indicate that PCMSS with a position loop can achieve high stability and speed precision relying on the position closed loop in the pump and the motor speed closed loop, whereas PCMSS without a position loop is unstable only depending on the speed closed loop. Therefore, to achieve nice performances for PCMSS, the displacement of a variable delivery pump should be independently adjusted while motor's rotary speed is fed back and controlled in closed loop.

articleTitle: Adaptive Kalman filter based maneuvering target tracking
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Visual servoing has been around for decades, but the time delay is still one of the most troublesome problems to achieve maneuvering target tracking. To circumvent the problem, in this paper, the Kalman filter is employed to estimate future position of the maneuvering object. In order to introduce the Kalman filter, the accurate time delays, which include the processing lag and the motion lag, need to be obtained. Thus, the delays of the visual control servoing systems are discussed, and a generic timing model for the system are provided. Then, we present a current statistical model for maneuvering target. An adaptive Kalman filter, which is evolved from the Kalman filter, is put forward based on the current statistical model. The results show that the modified adaptive filter can improve the ability of maneuvering target tracking.

articleTitle: The distance cycle slip detection and correction of a certain radar
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The segmental cycle slip of original distance data of a certain radar appears, and the traditional method can not process data. Based on this, the data fusion of exterior trajectory measurement equipment is calculated inversely, the difference of original data and inverse calculation data is done, and the scatter diagram of residual data is plot, detecting the existence of distance cycle slip. The regression analysis method is used to correct the cycle slip, and the confidence of the corrected data is given. Simulation results show that the distance cycle slip detection and correction is feasible, and it effectively improves the utilization of measurement data.

articleTitle: The Direct Torque Control (DTC) of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) based on the nonsingular terminal sliding mode (NTSM)
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: On the basis of the mathematical model of the PMSM, combining with the terminal sliding mode technology and DTC, the author has put forward the system of the DTC of the PMSM based on the NTSM which aims at solving such problems as the large ripple on flux linkage and torque, the difficulty of the precise control at a low speed of PMSM by DTC. In comparison with the traditional PI control, the NTSM can restrain itself in limited time and displays strong robustness to system parameters and outside interference. The singular phenomenon occurred in the terminal sliding mode is avoided through the adoption of the controller, and buffet which is common in regular sliding control is weaken. Therefore, the controlling effect of the whole system is improved considerably.

articleTitle: A study of a novel wind turbine structure for urban skyscrapers using CFD simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Worldwide interest in renewable energy options has given rise to emergence of new wind turbine system. In the present study, a novel wind turbine structure is introduced, which is specially designed for an urban environment. A computational modeling has been conducted to investigate the effect of the new structure on the flow behaviour of entrance wind through the structure and the feasibility of the new wind turbine working at different wind speed, such as low wind velocity in an urban area. The wind flow behaviour though a chamber of the wind turbine structure has resulted in an increase of 1.3 times of the wind velocity at the outlet of the wind turbine. This is equivalent to 2.5 times increase of wind energy. The wind energy concentration could be achieved, suitable to work in an urban area with low wind speed. It is evident that these simulation results are of importance in further optimisation of the shroud structure.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of lifting entry guidance for hypersonic vehicles
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Aimed at the requirements and characteristics of hypersonic lifting entry vehicles, the paper brings forward the performance evaluation indexes of entry guidance, establishes the numerically scored models of performance evaluation indexes, and designs a total of 26 kinds of test missions named EG1 to EG26. According to the test cases, by means of the Monte Carlo dispersions and the individual constant disturbance simulation, each performance index of entry guidance is numerically scored. Based on the weighted allocation strategy, a comprehensive evaluation on entry guidance law can be completed. Finally, the concrete steps and process about the evaluation method of entry guidance performance is given, which can be an important references and basis of performance evaluation on entry guidance for a class of lifting vehicles.

articleTitle: Robust guaranteed cost control for BTT vehicle based on LMI
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: BTT(Bank-to-Turn) vehicle is a kind of typical nonlinear system which has parametric uncertainty and heavy exogenous disturbance. This paper presents a partial linearization method use of robust guaranteed cost control techniques for the design and analysis of BTT vehicle control laws to make the model closer to the actual system. Considering the practical model of BTT vehicle, we employed partial linearization rather than complete linearization in system modeling, in order to prevent the system errors caused by low accuracy in complete linearization. Under the circumstance of satisfying Lipschitz conditions, Lyapunov function was employed to get the sufficient condition for the robust control law of the BTT vehicle system to exist, and transformed into a feasible solution with linear matrix inequalities method. The numerical simulation results show the algorithm can makes up the characteristic distortion of nonlinear system for excessive simplification model, so that the designed control law becomes more reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: High accurate pulse circuit design of transdermal drug delivery instrument
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Transdermal drug delivery system has an incomparable superiority to traditional medication systems, but its application was limited owing to low skin permeability. Aimed at the present situation, this paper analyzed the characters of dose-pulse based on the principle of transdermal drug delivery. Then several high accurate pulse waves and their combination are regenerated based on the theory of eleetroporation, sonophoresis and ontophoresis. Finally, Experimental results show that system effectively promotes drugs permeability through skin by regulation of frequency and intensity, and have good engineering value.

articleTitle: The simulation of Laser Doppler in Velocity measurement of rainwater in pipe
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This study aims to solve the difficulties in measuring the speed of rainwater in pipes. On the basis of the analysis about tracer particles size and number distribution in rainwater pipes and tracer particles velocity distribution, Laser Doppler in Velocity (LDV) was used in this paper to measure the speed of solid impurities within the rainwater pipe, which are regarded as the tracer particles that represent the speed of rainwater. In order to verify the feasibility of the LDV method in measuring the tracer particles in rainwater, a novel mathematic model of LDV, which is based on the theoretic model of fringes and the principle of light interfering and scattering, has been developed to simulate and analyze the relationship among the characteristics of the tracer particles, the velocity of rainwater and the accuracy of the velocity. Analog signals were obtained after simulation. The CHRONUX analysis and time-frequency analysis were used to find the frequency of the analog signals, and then convert the frequency into the speed of the rainwater in pipes. The results show that the method proposed in this study has relatively high accuracy, which is better than other methods of velocimeters. This study indicates that the LDV can apply to the speed measurement of rainwater in practice.

articleTitle: A study of Heuristic Searching approach for dynamic system modeling
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: A Multi-objects heuristic optimization approach for dynamic system modeling is presented. The optimizing process consists of two searching stages. At first, the optimal regions are explored by GA, which is one of the adaptive search algorithm and effective in many optimal problems. This can lead to compress the searching scope in the optimization effectively. Then the optimal solutions in these regions will be further searched respectively using Heuristic Searching Algorithm(HSA). Heuristic information in HAS is used to find the next searching directions in virtue of the gradient concepts. During the directions searching, evaluations of the results in multi-direction searching are made and the next step will be settle. Several nonlinear functions are used to test the HAS. The results and analysis are discussed. It shows the ability of model in the dynamic system modeling with the features of simplicity and flexibility.

articleTitle: An autonomic computing approach for coordinated temperature control in architectural interconnected environment
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Autonomic Computing is an interesting research area which promises to solve the complexity of computing systems. This paper discusses an autonomic computing based approach, which implement coordinated temperature control in an architectural interconnected environment. The components of the system are managed by autonomic managers, who can monitor, analyze and adapt to the situation. The managers decide proper management actions to improve the performance of system and to cooperate with each other. The proposed approach can realize decentralized control in the system, which provides the system with flexibility and scalability. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Integrated modeling and simulation for CAV aerodynamic and control
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: An aerodynamic and control integrated modeling and simulation approach is developed based on MATLAB in this paper. The parametric configuration generation method and aerodynamic engineering method is used to rapidly calculate aerodynamic forces. The LQR controller is designed to track attitude commands. With combination of aerodynamic calculation and control system on the MATLAB platform, the real-time simulation is conducted effectively and the results demonstrate the integrated approach.

articleTitle: Digital intermediate frequency module design of high-speed wireless broadband receiver
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Based on the design concept of software radio, the digital intermediate frequency module was constructed in the wireless broadband receiver in order to enable the functionality of frequency mixing, decimating, filtering and modulating. Digital intermediate frequency module mainly consists of CIC decimation filter, FIR filter, CIC interpolating filter and NCO. Arithmetic study has been done to all parts of digital intermediate frequency module. The digital intermediate frequency module was programmed with VHDL Hardware description language, and it is achieved in the chip of cyclone III Ep3c55f484-c8 FPGA manufactured by Altera International Limited. Gain flatness excels 3dB with 24MHz pass band for the wireless receiver based on the digital intermediate frequency module. Central frequency is 942MHz, and channel out-band rejection in 400KHz can reach 76dBc while restrained in 1MHz can reach 95dBc with time delay less than 10 ?s.

articleTitle: Aircraft intersection collision conflict detection and resolution under the control of A-SMGCS
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Airport surface operation process under the control of A-SMGCS (Advanced Surface Movement Guidance and Control System) is viewed as a kind of hybrid system. In order to detect and resolve aircraft taxi collision conflict, an Extended Hybrid Petri-nets (EHP) is proposed to model the surface operation in this paper. We study dynamics of the EHP model and show how the surface operation can be described through its state evolution. For the detection of aircraft intersection collision conflict, the discrete and continuous pre-alerting conditions and warning conditions are provided using hybrid state of EHP model. And then, the surface navigation lights are used to execute resolution strategies, leading to the reduction of air traffic controller's workload. Finally, algorithm for aircraft collision conflict detection and resolution is provided. As an example of application, the proposed algorithm is validated through Monte Carlo simulation under different surveillance precision for aircraft taxiing on intersection. The result demonstrates that the proposed algorithm could detect collision conflict and meet A-SMGCS requirements.

articleTitle: An edge growth segmentation arithmetic based on HSI color space
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: About the research of fire flame segmentation, the edge growth segmentation arithmetic proposed in the article uses HSI color vector as growth seed. This method makes full used of color images' color and space characteristics, it uses color's comparability of region color mean to confirm the edge pixels. According to the principle of region growth and border tracking, a close border line is shaped by edge growth rule, and then, edges' combination and segmentation is completed according to the connectivity among regions and comparability among colors. This segmentation arithmetic costs much less than traditional method.

articleTitle: Analysis of complexity measure of air traffic flow at terminal area based on approximate entropy
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In order to quantitatively describe the complexity of air traffic flow system at terminal area, the model of nonlinear dynamics, approximate entropy was introduced. The approximate entropy of two actual time series of air traffic flow at terminal area was calculated. The results show that air traffic flow at terminal area can be applied to effectively measure the randomicity and nonlinearity of a system and resolve the difficult problems of short sequence and comparability in depicting the complexity of a system. They are suitable to measure the complexity of the actual air traffic flow.

articleTitle: The research of magnetic flux door magnetic compass error compensation method
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper introduces a developed digital magnetic compass system based on the fluxgate technology. Firstly, to avoid stability problem caused by traditional RC analog drive circuit, digital square-wave signal from the MCU is applied to drive the fluxgate sensor. Then this system has adopted the median average filtering method to improve the accuracy and stability of the test data. The data of the magnetic field measurement value gets more accurate by this method. Finally, the system has compensated the constant external interference magnetic field to get the accurate direction. The design philosophy introduced in the paper has already been successfully applied to some type of digital magnetic compass.

articleTitle: Failure analysis of microstructure under shock load
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Reliability was one of the key issues in practical application of MEMS sensors and actuators while failure mode and mechanism of the microstructures was still lack of enough understanding. Based on the circumstance of a projectile launched in which the MEMS actuator works, a micro cantilever was selected as the representative object of study and the corresponding mechanical model under shock load was established to make failure analysis in this article. The effect of geometry parameters changing on the mechanical properties of the cantilever was studied. The result of theoretical analysis was verified the correctness through the FEM simulation. The conclusion of the research could be used to guide the failure analysis of micro device so as to provide theoretical basis for reliability design of MEMS sensor and actuator.

articleTitle: An energy efficient hop-number-constrained multi-hop routing algorithm for heterogeneous wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In this paper, the cluster-based network architecture combined with multi-hop transformation is studied and a hop-number-constrained multi-hop routing algorithm (HMR) is proposed. This new scheme is designed to prolong the network lifetime. In order to make sure that the communication period from sensor nodes to base station is stable, in this new scheme, the maximum hop-number is considered. Meanwhile, nodes with higher residual energy undertake more tasks of relaying information so as to balance the energy consumption in the network. Simulation results show that this new scheme provides longer lifetime than the classical clustering algorithms, and HMR also reaches larger amount of effective messages.

articleTitle: ADXRS401 angular velocity measurement system based on TMS320F2812 and AD7898
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: In order to measure the high precision simultaneous angular velocity of MEMS gyroscope, ADXRS401, we designed a stable and available simultaneous serial data acquisition system, which is mainly built based on TMS320F2812, DSP chip of TI, and AD7898, AD converter of ADI. AD7898 could convert analog signal to digital signal and transfer the collected data to TMS320F2812 by the serial port-Multichannel Buffered Serial PORT (McBSP). After the pretreatment of TMS320F2812, the collected data would be transferred to the PC by the module of wireless transmission. At last, the PC could draw the waveform graph of the collected data and calculate the minimum and maximum value. We could easily estimate the designed system good or not. After the joint debug of software and hardware, we could make it better meet the design requirements. The design of hardware interface circuits, design of software procedures, and debug of hardware and software etc. are described in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on modeling and simulation of equipment maintenance support based on queuing theory
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: This paper analysis the maintenance support problems of the equipment with limited customer resource's theory of waiting queuing system, and do a simulation research on the mean number of malfunction and the mean time of waiting for maintenance with Matlab7.1 programming. And also, the distribution uniformity test of random number and error analysis for the simulation results is conducted. Therefore, a scientific and effective method used to forecast the amount of the maintenance work of the equipment and determine the scale of the force of the maintenance support is provided.

articleTitle: Design of a adaptive decoupling control law of miniature duct fan UAV
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: An adaptive decoupling control method for a miniature ducted-fan UAV is studied in this article. In order to make the UAV's outputs steadily follow established reference model in the condition of parameter perturbation and uncertain disturbance, an adaptive control method is designed based on the Model Reference Adaptive Control, which is built in order to control one of the fast state variables, the UAV's angular speed. In the meantime, a cascade feed forward decoupling control is designed for the known reference model, to make the fast state variable decouple synchronously along with the reference model, and then control the UAV's attitude and angular velocity. Simulation results show that the control law makes the UAV's attitude outputs steadily follow outputs of the reference model, the coupling interaction between control channels is eliminated, and the controller is not sensitive to parameter perturbation. The control system is strongly adaptive and robust.

articleTitle: The 3-input Euler polynomial neuronet (3IEPN) with weights-and-structure-determination (WASD) algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Based on the function approximation theory and the Weierstrass approximation theorem, a novel 3-input Euler polynomial neuronet (3IEPN) is established in this paper to fit the 4-dimensional data (i.e., data in the form of 3 inputs and 1 output). In order to achieve satisfactory performance and efficacy of the 3IEPN, a weights-and-structure-determination (WASD) algorithm, which is based on the weights-direct-determination (WDD) method, is built up for the established 3IEPN. Numerical results further substantiate the superior performance of the proposed 3IEPN equipped with the WASD algorithm in terms of training, validation and prediction.

articleTitle: A cooperative stochastic differential game of industrial pollution
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The thought of cooperation in environmental control holds out the best promise of effective action, limited success has been observed because existing multi-participants joint initiatives fail to satisfy the property of subgame consistency. A cooperative solution is subgame consistent if the solution optimality principle is maintained in any subgame which starts at a later time with any feasible state brought about by prior optimal behaviors. In this paper we present a cooperative differential game of industrial pollution with industry and farmer. The novel feature is provided. A subgame consistent cooperative solution is derived in this differential game together with a payment distribution mechanism that supports the subgame consistent solution. The expected gain from cooperation is shared proportionally to the participants' relative sizes of expected noncooperative payoffs. The participants can secure cooperative optimality which maximizes their joint expected payoff. There is guarantee that participants will always be better off within the entire duration of the agreement.

articleTitle: Implementation of vision algorithm for SRV-1 mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: The latest research in the field of autonomous robotics is focused on the development of novel principles and approaches to address the process of adaptation and evolution in multi-robotic systems. To achieve the task, every individual robot is required to have the ability to interact with the environment, with other robots and to keep on localizing itself. In this research, an vision based obstacle avoidance approach, to provide the concrete base for localizing the individual robots in multi-robotic environment, is addressed. The development of this vision algorithm is based on the library of basic vision algorithms which is developed in this research for the vision system based on Blackfin BF537 processor. The computer vision system is also, useful in several applications of autonomous vehicles, such as map generation, obstacle avoidance tasks, positioning tasks and target tracking. Furthermore, computer vision can provide a significant gain in reliability, versatility and accuracy of robotic tasks, which are important concerns in most applications.

articleTitle: Some new deformation formulas about variance and covariance
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: Based on the idea of the difference method, in this paper, the difference method is applied to the calculation of the variance and covariance. The variance and covariance formulas are transformed as some new formulas by the difference method. The articles presented some original new variance and covariance formulas whose form that contains the individual difference, and leads to some corresponding new expansion formulas. The calculation of the variance and covariance about this method is less implicated with the changes of the overall sample. Finally, the theoretical analysis and practical application of image denoising show the feasibility of the new formula.

articleTitle: The variable selection for the level control of continuous casting mould based on the BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 Proceedings of International Conference on Modelling, Identification and Control
abstract: According to the problems in the practical application in the level control of the continuous casting mould, a solution is put forward, about variable selection method, which based on improved BP neural network. It can give full scope to the self-learning, adaptive and fault tolerant capability of the BP neural network. It can select the variable to the results have important implications, that to control the level constant as the input of the control system. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the solution.
